method: Mirrors tests/test_phase2_replay_parity.py's methodology for R_75: the same real, hand-built GBP/USD candle bundle (from checkpoint 16's tests/phase4_gbpusd_fixtures.py) is run through the real build_decision() once, then normalized twice -- once with live=True (LIVE) and once with live=False (REPLAY) -- at the identical analysis_timestamp, and the two resulting products are compared field-for-field on every named parity field plus a full structural-equality check with only the two intentional distinguishing fields (overlay_mode, meta.live) neutralized.

required_fields_verified.dealing_range: PASS -- forex.dealing_range identical (range_high/low, equilibrium, current_position_pct, premium_discount_state)
required_fields_verified.fvg_ownership: PASS -- setup ownership identical (decision_owner_id/overlay_owner_id both ict_2022 in both modes)
required_fields_verified.order_block_ownership: N/A -- no order-block engine exists for Forex (documented in checkpoint 10/23; nothing to diverge)
required_fields_verified.setup_id: PASS -- identical (deterministic stable_id, independent of live/replay framing)
required_fields_verified.overlays: PASS on overlay *type* sequence; the previous-setup historical marker row is intentionally LIVE/PREVIOUS_SETUP-only by design (global_overlay_contract.py), never included in REPLAY -- confirmed as deliberate, not a defect, and excluded from the full-equality assertion accordingly

full_structural_equality: PASS -- test_only_the_intended_live_vs_replay_distinguishing_fields_differ: after neutralizing overlay_mode/meta.live and excluding the by-design historical-row overlay difference, the two products are exactly equal
no_lookahead: PASS -- test_no_lookahead_a_truncated_gbpusd_history_cannot_see_future_candles: identical results at the same analysis_timestamp regardless of how much future M15/M5 history is appended to the frame (reconfirms checkpoint 7's guarantee against a fresh fixture)
